projects.description: 1M SF distribution center on 34-acre Port of Chehalis site. Robotics floor, mezzanine, conveyors. 500. 1,000 jobs. Permits approved May 2026.
projects.open_for: Under construction. Logistics MEP and material handling specs.

projects.name: Woodbridge Corporate Park Warehouse Expansion
projects.owner: Stock Families / Panattoni Development. Industrial Realty Group (IRG)
projects.description: 1.03 million SF industrial warehouse proposed on the former Wild Waves Theme Park site in Federal Way, leased to Panattoni Development. Features dock-high loading on east and west sides. 971,390 SF total expansion across 3 warehouse properties with office space at Woodbridge Corporate Park (former Weyerhaeuser campus) in Federal Way. Public land use hearing held June 8, 2026.

sources.title: Giant warehouse planned for Wild Waves property in Federal Way - Covington Reporter

projects.open_for: Permitting. Shell, dock equipment, and HVAC procurement. Permitting. Shell, MEP, roofing, paving.

projects.name: Confluence Health Central Campus Cancer Care Center
projects.description: 11,000 SF building addition and 25,000 SF interior tenant improvement renovation ($60M total) at Confluence Health Central Hospital campus in Wenatchee to consolidate radiation oncology and infusion therapy.

sources.title: Confluence Health applies for permit for new cancer care center - Wenatchee World

projects.open_for: Permitting. Medical interior TI, HVAC, radiation equipment shielding.
